title: The Alchemist (Beta Branch)
description:
[quote]This mod is for the beta version of the game. Here is the public version: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3781688551[/quote]

The Alchemist is a new character for Slay the Spire 2: a curious frog who will drink anything once, on a personal journey through the Spire. They balance their own poison to quickly get stronger, mix up potion-like cards during combat while letting other cards ferment in hand until they're ready, and brew special potions at Rest Sites that can be sold to the Merchant.

[h2]Overview[/h2]
[list]
[*] ✨ 100+ new cards
[*] 💎 9 new relics
[*] 🧪 11 new potions
[*] 📚 7 timeline epochs
[*] 🎨 Handmade art and animation
[*] 🌍 Translated into 15 languages
[*] 🐸 You get to be a frog
[/list]

[h2]Playstyle[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Poison[/b]: The Alchemist doses themselves on purpose. Some attacks deal more damage the more Poison you have, and other cards trigger every time your Poison does. There are also many ways to apply Poison to enemies.
[*] [b]Antitoxin[/b]: Protects you from your own Poison. Each time your Poison triggers, Antitoxin prevents up to that much damage. It isn't used up, but it goes down by 1 at the start of each turn just like Poison.
[*] [b]Mixes[/b]: 0-cost cards you create in combat that have effects similar to potions. The basic Mixes are Bursting (damage), Syrupy (Block) and Zesty (draw). The volatile Mixes are Fuming (damage to all enemies and Tainted), Acrid (Weak and Vulnerable) and Sparkling (Energy).
[*] [b]Ferment[/b]: These cards Retain and get more potent for every turn they stay in your hand. There are ways to manipulate these Fermentation levels to gain an edge.
[*] [b]Brew[/b]: A new Rest Site option that upgrades a random card in your deck and lets you choose 1 of 3 special potions. Due to the quality of these brews, the Merchant is willing to buy them from you for 100 Gold.
[/list]

[h2]Disclaimer[/h2]
This mod is still a work in progress and content is subject to change, but feedback is welcome! The best place to talk about the mod is the Alchemist post in #modding-forum on the official Slay the Spire Discord server (link below).

Language translations are auto-generated for now. The plan is to commission native translators once the content changes slow down. In the meantime, corrections are appreciated! If you see an error in your language, please contact me or feel free to open a pull request on GitHub.

If you turn on anonymous run sharing, your runs help balance the character. You can see the results from every player, along with every card, relic, potion and patch note, at https://alchemist.fyi/

changeNote:
v0.15.0

Added

- Added Cocktail Strike card (Reshuffled Spire): "Deal 4 damage. Deals 4 (5) additional damage for each unique Mix you have played this combat."
- Added Dregs status card (Reshuffled Spire): "Unplayable. Ethereal. Whenever you draw this card, gain 2 Poison and draw 1 card."
- Added Fester card (Reshuffled Spire): "Apply 2 (3) Poison. Trigger the enemy's Poison 1 (2) times."
- Added Hopped Up card (Reshuffled Spire): "Deal 4 (5) damage 4 times. Costs 1 less for every 4 Poison you have."
- Added Let It Settle card (Reshuffled Spire): "Gain 9 (12) Block. Add a Dregs into your Draw Pile."
- Added One for Later card (Reshuffled Spire): "Whenever you add a Mix into your Hand, add a copy of it into your Draw Pile."
- Added Switcheroo card (Reshuffled Spire): "Gain 3 Poison. Swap your Poison with the enemy's Poison. Exhaust."
- Added Toxic Aura card (Reshuffled Spire): "Whenever your Poison triggers, deal that much damage to ALL enemies."
- Added Turn Sour card (Reshuffled Spire): "Retain. Ferment. Apply 1 (2) Weak. Apply 1 (2) Vulnerable. Applies 1 additional Weak and Vulnerable for each turn Fermented. Exhaust."
- Added Warning Colors card (Reshuffled Spire): "Whenever you are attacked, apply 1 Poison for every 3 Antitoxin you have." Warning Colors+ gains Innate

Changed

- Buffed Double Dip card (Hero Expansion): Poison increased from 5(7) -> 6(8)
- Buffed Muscle Memory card (Hero Expansion): damage increased from 3(4) -> 4(5)
- Buffed Wormwood card: Poison increased from 2(3) -> 3(4)
- Changed Fizz card: it now adds a Fuming Mix (Fuming Mix+) instead of a Bursting Mix (Bursting Mix+)
- Nerfed Bounce Back card (Hero Expansion): Block decreased from 7(9) -> 6(8)
- Renamed special Mixes (Fuming, Acrid and Sparkling) to volatile Mixes
- Reworked Pick and Choose card: "Scry 2 (3). Draw 1 card. Discard 1 card. Gain 2 (3) Antitoxin."
- Reworked Rerun card: "This turn, your next card is played an extra time. Gain 5 (3) Poison."
- Reworked Secret Sauce card (Hero Expansion): "Choose a basic Mix (Mix+) to add into your Hand. Enchant an Attack in your Hand with Laced."

Fixed

- Fixed Caustic Strike not being properly tagged as a Strike
- Fixed Effervesce and Free Samples triggering the receiving player's Runoff instead of your own
- Fixed Form power effects being drawn in front of the Alchemist instead of behind
